```yaml
name: Benchmark and Security Audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  security-audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true
          
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: .
          
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check
        
      - name: Clippy checks
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
        
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --lib
        
      - name: Run all tests
        run: cargo test --all
        
      - name: Build release
        run: cargo build --release

  benchmark:
    needs: security-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true
          
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: .
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq curl
          
      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          cargo run --bin waf-detector -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json
        env:
          WAF_DETECTOR_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WAF_DETECTOR_API_TOKEN }}
          
      - name: Validate benchmark results
        run: |
          # Verify benchmark output exists and has expected structure
          if [ ! -f "benchmark_results.json" ]; then
            echo "Benchmark results file not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Validate JSON structure
          jq . benchmark_results.json > /dev/null
          
          # Check minimum accuracy threshold (example: 80%)
          ACCURACY=$(jq '.overall_accuracy' benchmark_results.json)
          if (( $(echo "$ACCURACY < 0.8" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "Benchmark accuracy below threshold of 80%"
            exit 1
          fi
          
      - name: Upload benchmark results
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
        with:
          benchmark-results-dir: .
          benchmark-name: waf-detector-benchmark
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          schema-version: "1.0"

  va2-maturity:
    needs: security-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true
          
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: .
          
      - name: Test VA2 endpoints
        run: |
          # Test async VA2 job endpoints
          # This would require running the server and making HTTP requests
          # For now we'll just ensure the code compiles and tests pass
          cargo test virtual_adversary2
          
      - name: Validate challenge taxonomy
        run: |
          cargo test challenge_type_enum
          
      - name: Validate content-length delta
        run: |
          cargo test content_length_delta

  trust-productization:
    needs: security-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true
          
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: .
          
      - name: Test security posture metadata
        run: |
          cargo test security_posture_metadata
          
      - name: Test deterministic replay bundle
        run: |
          cargo test deterministic_replay_bundle
          
      - name: Test production mode enforcement
        run: |
          # Test that prod mode enforces token auth
          # This requires manual verification or integration testing
          cargo test prod_mode_enforcement
          
      - name: Test insecure TLS rejection
        run: |
          cargo test insecure_tls_rejection

  security-hardening:
    needs: security-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true
          
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: .
          
      - name: Test CORS policy
        run: |
          cargo test cors_policy
          
      - name: Test API token auth
        run: |
          cargo test api_token_auth
          
      - name: Test consent target validation
        run: |
          cargo test consent_target_validation
          
      - name: Test DNS rebinding fix
        run: |
          cargo test dns_rebinding_fix
          
      - name: Test CSRF protection
        run: |
          cargo test csrf_protection
          
      - name: Test insecure TLS warnings
        run: |
          cargo test insecure_tls_warnings

  detection-quality:
    needs: security-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true
          
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: .
          
      - name: Test benchmark corpus
        run: |
          # Verify benchmark corpus exists and is valid
          if [ ! -f "benchmark_corpus.json" ]; then
            echo "Benchmark corpus file not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          jq . benchmark_corpus.json > /dev/null
          
      - name: Test offline evaluator
        run: |
          cargo run --bin waf-detector -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json
          
      - name: Test cross-provider negatives
        run: |
          cargo test cross_provider_negatives
          
      - name: Test accuracy threshold gate
        run: |
          # This would be validated by the benchmark job above
          echo "Accuracy threshold validation handled in benchmark job"
```
